_note: The variant matrix. The build takes the cartesian product of the axes below,
so this file is the only place that knows how many themes exist.
TO ADD A VALUE TO AN AXIS:
1. Drop the fragment in the axis 'dir' ('_<name>.scss' for palette and
density, '<name>.json' for icons). Copy an existing one; every fragment
on an axis must define the same names.
2. Add its name to that axis's 'values'.
The build discovers the files on disk and fails if they disagree with this
list, so step 2 cannot be silently forgotten and a stray file cannot become
TO ADD A WHOLE NEW AXIS: add it here with its own dir and suffix, then teach
_tokens.scss to consume whatever names its fragments define. build.py needs
no change; it already products every axis it finds.
Every combination is packed and none is privileged. There is no default and
no alias file: a theme is named for the choices that produced it, and there
is nothing to keep in step with a 'recommended' one.
